Steinesatz Fiat 500

https://makerworld.com/de/models/1496323-brick-fiat-500-set#profileId-3641609

This model took a lot of time and patience to complete every single piece and was meticulously designed to fit together properly. Depending on the type of filament and 3D printer you use, some sizes may need slight adjustments for the best fit. Instructions can be found in the comments. Enjoy the build and have fun bringing this iconic set! 

 

Printing Instructions

Before You Print

* Make sure the build plate is clean (wipe with isopropyl alcohol or dawn for best bed adhesion).
* Ensure the nozzle is clean and properly tightened.
* Load dry, good-quality filament for best results.
Print Instructions 

* Use RED BRICK FAST Profile preset inside project
* Each plate is labeled By the color needed
* Print each plate with each correct color if you want to get the same outcome is the image  
Filament Recommendations

* Designed to print easily in PLA.
During the Print

* Watch the first layer to ensure good adhesion.
* If edges lift, re-clean the plate or slow the first layer speed.
After Printing

* Let the part cool before removing to avoid warping.
* Remove any supports if there are any
Stickers

* Included in the zip file which you can initially download is all the individual STL files if you have issues with a piece 
* Also has a pdf which has the stickers for you to print
Final Notes

* Just slice, print, and enjoy!
* If you have issues, feel free to leave a comment and ill get it fixed
* THIS MODEL IS DESIGNED TO WORK WITH MY BRICKS AND WILL LICKELY NOT FIT WITH OTHER ONES

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: Red Brick Bag 1
- Schichthöhe: 0.1 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PLA (#FFFFFF)
